violations.corrective_action: Provide end caps to completely enclose the light bulb. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM will shield the light bulbs.

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: SOUR CREAM (41F) WAS STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER WITHOUT MARKING OPENING DATE.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. CFM MARKED THE FOOD ITEM WITH OPENING DATE.

violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. CFM ORDERED SOME SIGNAGES IMMEDIATELY. SALSA ROOM, THE (Inspection Date: 08/19/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN STORED ABOVE RAW BEEF IN FALCON 2-DOOR FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CFM REORGANIZED THE FOOD ITEMS.

violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: SHREDDED CHEDDAR CHEESE AND MONTEREY JACK CHEESE WAS OPENED ON 8/16/2025 AND STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER WITHOUT DATE MARKING.

These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. CFM ORDERED 2 THERMOMETERS IMMEDIATELY.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: A. SQUEEZE BOTTLE OF BBQ SAUCE STORED IN AVANTCO 3-DOOR COOLER WAS NOT PROPERLY LABELED.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM LABELED THE SQUEEZE BOTTLE PROPERLY.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SALSA (47F) WAS STORED IN AVANTCO 3-DOOR PREP COOLER FOR MORE THAN 4 HOURS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEM.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: SALSA (47F) WAS PREPARED ON MARCH 1ST, 2025. BY THE TIME OF INSPECTION, IT HAS BEEN STORED IN AVANTCO 3-DOOR PREP COOLER FOR 2 DAYS WITHOUT DATE MARKING.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS DISCUSSED DATE MARKING WITH CFM.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: (1) AMBIENT TEMPERATURE OF AVANTCO 3-DOOR PREP COOLER WAS 45F DURING INSPECTION. (2) DUE TO COOLING PROBLEM, AVANTCO 3-D0OR FLAT TOP COOLER IS NOT IN USE.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE TWO COOLERS AND FORWARD THE SERVICE REPORT TO EHS WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED AN UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS SHARED THE INFORMATION OF APPROVED SPLITTER WITH CFM. CFM WILL NEED TO INSTALL AN APPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK WITHIN 3 CALENDAR DAYS.
